usedFor: SandeshChat receives messages, and HubSpot turns a new sender into a contact through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Inbound Message Arrives” in SandeshChat, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: An inbound message is a buyer reaching out, so a deal opens for follow-up.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so check the inbound message gives you one.
